bias_targets.methodology: Literature review of how synthetic data generation (such as using style transfer to mimic different skin tones in photoplethysmogram [PPG] data) is used to evaluate and mitigate performance disparities in optical medical devices like pulse oximeters across diverse phenotypes.

Theoretical evaluation and review of how underrepresentation of minority groups in medical datasets leads to systemic inequalities in healthcare AI, proposing the generation of synthetic humans/digital twins to blend difficult phenotypes and balance dataset demographics.
